svg.aria-label: A parked chat with cache warming on. The engine runs until your park time, then stops. One minute before each warm is due, the engine starts in the background, sends the warm and parks again. Your next message starts the engine, and it sends the same bytes, so the warm cache hits.
svg.text: A parked chat, with cache warming on
1. At your "Park idle chats after" time, the engine process stops. The chat stays.
2. One minute before a warm is due, the engine starts in the background, sends the warm and parks again.
3. Your next message starts the engine. It sends the same bytes, so the warm cache hits.
Each warm is a request that uses tokens. With warming off, a parked chat stays parked.
